name.description: Unique identifier for the datacenter (no spaces)

description.description: Human-readable description shown in UI and logs

smtpserver.description: SMTP server host to use for sending email notifications

storage.description: Default storage pool for VM/CT disk images

backup_storage.description: Default storage pool for VM/CT backups

backup_schedule.description: Cron-like schedule for automatic backups (e.g., '0 2 * * *' for daily at 2 AM); leave empty to disable

ha_enabled.description: Enable cluster-wide High Availability (HA) for VMs/containers

ha_default_group.description: Default HA resource group for new protected resources

ha_startup_delay.description: Seconds to wait before starting next resource after a node join or failover

ha_restart_count.description: Maximum number of restart attempts for a failing resource

timezone.description: Default system timezone for this datacenter (e.g., 'America/New_York')

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to configure cluster-wide

items.description: IP address of a DNS server
